entities.summary: Vygonoschanskoye Lake is located in the Ivatsevichy Raion, Brest Voblast, of Belarus. It is the sixth largest lake in Belarus. Its area is 26 km2 (10 sq mi). Its maximum depth is 2.3 m (8 ft) and its average depth is 1.2 m (4 ft).
